newsitem.title: USA: Tandy appoints Computer City CEO.
newsitem.headline: Tandy appoints Computer City CEO.

text.p: Tandy Corp has appointed Nathan Morton co-chairman and chief executive at its Computer City operations, the company said in a statement.
It also said that John Roach, Tandy's CEO would become co-chair, appointed Avery More as vice chairman and Robert Boutin is to be chief financial officer.
The three new executives have agreed to acquire 19.9 percent of Computer City or cash and notes at book value and will evaluate setting the company up as an independent company.
Roach said that the management changes should accelerate yje turnaround at Computer City.
